title: NIDAR image front end for behavior cloning: exploratory simulation
scope: Frozen nominal-light development evaluation and a separate new-initial-state evaluation; not the complete experiment history.

protocol.environment: robosuite Lift with Panda and five cubes
protocol.stop: first success, environment done, or horizon

inputs.derived_cues: Pseudo-NIR and R are computed from RGB; no additional NIR sensor.
inputs.fusion: Frozen BC-RNN with FiLM; C adds a bounded low-frequency R residual to fixed B.
inputs.display: Current frame of all image inputs, fixed 0-1 display range. Wide camera is for visualization only.
inputs.bc_frontend: Reuses pseudo-NIR translation and intrinsic-decomposition front end; no point-cloud projection, geometry modulation, or quantile remapping in this BC path.

scene.note: Target and distractors also differ slightly in dimensions, mass and orientation. No measured NIR reflectance or LiDAR intensity ground truth is used in this scene.

interpretation: D0 full application exceeds RGBD by 2/60 and matches the fixed pseudo-NIR policy; it does not establish an independent R success-rate gain. D1 has B 55/60 and C 53/60, so consistent initial-state generalization is not established.
